content.short: Community Gaming is an automated esports tournament platform that enables instant payouts and transparent competition via smart contracts.
content.description: Community Gaming is a cutting-edge platform designed to automate the organization and payment processes for competitive gaming. By using smart contracts to handle tournament entry and prize distribution, it ensures that players receive their rewards instantly and transparently. Partnered with the Mantle Network, Community Gaming leverages low fees and fast finality to power a new generation of scalable esports events and quests for the global gaming community.
